description: This file defines a plugin tool for code execution within an openclaw-based environment, including configuration reading, enabling logic, and an async execute function that interacts with external APIs for sandboxed Python analysis.

methods.name: readCodeExecutionConfigRecord
methods.description: Reads a CodeExecutionConfig object and returns a record of its properties if valid.

methods.name: readPluginCodeExecutionConfig
methods.description: Extracts the codeExecution configuration from the plugin's OpenClawConfig.

methods.name: resolveCodeExecutionEnabled
methods.description: Determines if code execution is enabled based on configuration and runtime settings.

methods.name: createCodeExecutionTool
methods.description: Creates a tool object for sandboxed Python code execution if enabled in configuration.
